scenario_summary: Customer needs to access their account without original credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Minh Nguyen and I'm 26. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Minh. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I can't look up an account by name alone. Could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the credit card used for the purchase so I can attempt to locate the profile?
Oh, okay. The address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.
Thanks for that info. I've located a matching account. To proceed with any account changes or refunds, I need to verify your identity. Can you confirm the date of your last transaction with us?
I think it was around two weeks ago? Maybe the 12th?

That matches our records. Per our standard security policy, I cannot process a refund request without verifying the specific order reference number. Since you don't have it, I'll need to escalate this to our Account Recovery team who can perform a manual identity verification.
That sounds like a lot of work. Is there really no other way to just issue the refund now?

I apologize for the inconvenience, but our protocols are quite strict regarding unverified refund requests to prevent unauthorized access. I've opened a case for you, and a specialist will reach out to your registered email once they verify your identity.

escalation_reason: Customer failed to provide order reference number and requested sensitive account actions (refund) without full identity verification, necessitating manual review by the Account Recovery team.
